20297.ins: Printed cm measurements - length 60, bust 70-120, waist 60-90 - put this listing a standard above the category's usual guesswork. The 40-65 kg band is wider than most one-size claims, and the numbers are there to verify it before ordering.
20297.short: Black OL secretary set with short skirt and tie in polyester, one size for 40-65 kg with printed cm measurements, three pieces.

20315.ins: Seven pieces in rose lace is the fullest maid kit on the site, and the rose pattern ties the accessories to the outfit at the fabric level rather than the color level. See-through throughout, as the listing name states and the pictures confirm.
20315.short: Seven-piece rose lace maid set from headband to leg rings in see-through fabric, one size for 40-60 kg, as pictured.

20321.ins: The openwork apron gives the set its depth - cutwork over the outfit reads as craft rather than print, which is what separates the formal end of the maid category from the casual. M and L split at 60 kg; order by the band, not the label.
20321.short: Japanese Lolita maid set with openwork apron and seven pieces, M for 40-60 kg and L for 60-65 kg, as pictured in polyester.

20329.ins: The leg loops take the garter role in a smaller format, and the sleeves add the formality that strapless bridal sets skip. White and black versions share the five-piece cut, so the color decision changes mood without changing contents.
20329.short: Five-piece bridal set with veil, top, panties, leg loops and sleeves in white or black, one size for 40-60 kg, wedding night ready.

20337.ins: The chest patch is a selective-coverage decision the fully open alternatives never make - it covers what it covers and leaves the rest, which is a different read than either extreme. Stockings arrive in the set, answering the usual open question.
20337.short: Open-chest secretary set with dress, thong, chest patch and stockings, one size for 40-60 kg, office romance costume as pictured.

20342.ins: Patent leather shifts the little devil costume from cute to serious, and the collar carries the theme in place of wings and horns - a cleaner silhouette that stores flat and wipes clean. Black and red split the classic from the infernal.
20342.short: Patent leather little devil set with dress, collar and thong in black or red, one size for 40-60 kg, midnight succubus styling.

20343.ins: Five pieces in three colorways gives the three-point cat set the configuration range of a much larger category - the neck ring identifies the cat, the bracelets and leg rings finish the silhouette, and the colorway sets the mood.
20343.short: Three-point cat girl set with five pieces in black, white or pink polyester, one size for 40-60 kg, minimal coverage costume.

20345.ins: Nylon mesh is sheerer than chiffon and stretches further, which is why this listing claims 40-70 kg - the widest single-size range in the costume category. Gray suits the fabric's character; brighter shades would fight the sheerness.
20345.short: Sheer gray nylon-mesh kitty suit with headdress, bracelet and stockings, one size for 40-70 kg, the widest range on site.

20382.ins: JK as a style word means the Japanese school aesthetic - the collar line, the cut, the proportions - and this sheer version stays in bedroom territory where the structured versions go to costume parties. Pink or black in the same cut.
20382.short: Sheer JK student lingerie in pink or black polyester, one size for 40-60 kg, Japanese school aesthetic in as-pictured single piece.

20383.ins: Four coordinated pieces with the cat theme carried by headwear and neck ring rather than print - the jumpsuit itself stays plain, which suits wearers who prefer the costume cues removable. Three colorways, open-crotch construction as named.
20383.short: Cat girl open-crotch jumpsuit with headwear, bracelet and neck ring in black, pink or white, one size for 40-60 kg.
